_note: Strict, recipe-owned spec read by c-eval-runner. Final target is interim/render/reel.mp4 (before R2 upload). A brand may layer brand-overrides/<slug>/acceptance.json to TIGHTEN thresholds (same id wins; new ids appended). See c-eval-runner/SKILL.md for the spec format.

checks.desc: Mechanical gate (loudness ≈ -14 LUFS, frame-0 brightness, resolution 1080×1920, fps, audio present) delegated to c-shorts-qa-gate.
Faceless HyperFrames reel: 20–40s target (VO is the duration master); 18–42s allows ±2s for mux rounding and short/long VO scripts.
Exact 9:16 portrait canvas. HyperFrames must be authored with data-width=1080 data-height=1920.
Frame 0 must not be black — YAVG ≥ 30 on the full frame at the 2% mark (≈0.4s in on a 20s reel). Enforces the mandatory 'Frame 0 is NEVER black' rule; GSAP entrances must land by this point.

(a) Exactly one text beat is visible at any sampled timestamp — no two beats' text are stacked or jumbled on screen simultaneously. Verify each sample frame has a single legible headline, not multiple overlapping lines from different scenes.

(b) B-roll clips (if supplied) are visible in their allocated scene windows — no dark or blank rectangle where footage should appear. A blank b-roll window means the clip was not localized (remote URL in <video src> fails in the headless render).
(c) All on-screen text is legible at mobile size — headlines ≥60px, body ≥20px, adequate contrast against the background per the Step 0 identity palette. No text is clipped by the canvas edge.
(d) Brand palette from Step 0 (dark-premium or DESIGN.md) is applied — not defaulted to generic white-on-black or unbranded colors (#333, #3b82f6 defaults are a skip-gate defect).

(e) No static stretch exceeding 3 seconds — every sampled window shows entrance, ambient, or transition motion. A frozen composition for more than 3s is a defect (GSAP ambient must be present on decoratives between beats).

(f) Frame 0 is a bright money-shot composition — not black, not a blank pre-entrance state, not a loading artifact. The first frame must be the cover-freeze of the strongest illustrative beat (as required by the frame integrity rule).
ElevenLabs VO must be loudnormed to -14 LUFS ±1.5 before mux — the VO is the audio spine of the reel.
VO must contain clear speech signal: mean_volume between -35 and -10 dBFS. Below -35 = near-silent; above -10 = clipping.
HyperFrames render must produce exact 1080×1920 before VO mux. A mismatched canvas means the composition data-width/height were wrong.
